**Placement Process**

• **Registration**: Starts in 7th semester
• **Campus Drives**: 8th semester
• **Process**: Registration → Pre-placement Talk → Written Test → Technical Interview → HR Interview → Offer

Check the placement portal for upcoming drives and eligibility.

**Placement Eligibility**

• Minimum **60% aggregate** (overall CGPA)
• **No active backlogs**
• Clear all **fee dues**
• Attend all **placement activities**
• Maintain decent **behavior** during the process

Some companies may have higher criteria.

**Required Documents**

• Updated Resume (2-3 copies)
• All semester marks cards (original + copy)
• Passport size photographs (3-4)
• ID proof (Aadhar/Pan)
• Placement registration form

Keep all documents ready before each drive.

**Top Recruiters** (typically visit our campus)

• IT Services: TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Accenture, Cognizant
• Product: Amazon, Google, Microsoft
• Consulting: Deloitte, EY, PwC
• Core: Bosch, Mercedes, Tata Steel

Packages vary from 3-15 LPA depending on company and profile.

**Average Packages by Department**

• **Computer Science**: 4-8 LPA
• **Electronics**: 3.5-6 LPA
• **Mechanical**: 3-5 LPA
• **Civil**: 3-4.5 LPA
• **Electrical**: 3-5 LPA

Top packages can go up to 15+ LPA for elite companies.

Our college has a strong placement record with 85%+ students placed annually. Average package: 4.5 LPA. Top recruiters across all departments visit regularly. Department faculty will share detailed statistics.
